findings: Auto-translate toggle logic fragile — The translation link is broken if a user manually types into an auto-translated field then clears it. Auto-link detection relies on state flags; clearing a field doesn't reset the flag, so subsequent auto-typing won't retrigger auto-fill.

Mobile image drag-drop may not work on iOS — HTML5 drag-and-drop is unreliable on iOS touch devices without a polyfill. Mobile users cannot reorder images by dragging; touch-specific alternatives are not implemented.
Bottom nav compare bar positioning — The compare bar uses `absolute -top-14` and may overlap or misalign on devices with unusual safe-area insets. Testing on notched devices recommended.

No explicit TypeScript null-check in AddListingPage for debounce refs — Refs are checked before use but TypeScript does not enforce they exist at cleanup. If the component unmounts mid-debounce, cleanup may fail silently.

Listing card list layout shrinks responsively but has no min breakpoint — The `w-40 sm:w-56` logic means on mobile below 375px viewport the card image is constrained to 160px, potentially causing overflow on very small devices.
